title: Build fails on Next.js 16 because a parallel route slot has no default.js
symptoms: Missing required default.js file for parallel route at app/@modal
An @modal or @sidebar slot that built on Next.js 15 now fails next build
cause: Next.js 16 requires an explicit default.js in every parallel route slot. Earlier versions fell back quietly when a slot had no match on hard navigation.
fix: Add default.tsx to each slot that returns null, or calls notFound() if that is the intended behavior.
affected: Next.js 16.0 and later, App Router parallel routes
